project_info.theme: Road-to football festival event map with transport offers
project_info.color_palette: Light blue, royal blue, white, orange, yellow, red

main_subject.detail: A dense infographic-style event poster mapping a route from a be scooter to a GO! shopping center and then to a football festival activation zone, combining large promo text, numbered route points, speech-bubble activity callouts, and several event booth mockups.
main_subject.style: Isometric event infographic poster, partnership activation map, high-information promotional visual

composition_elements.text: be, FPT, ROAD TO ĐẠI TIỆC BÓNG ĐÁ FPT, ĐẶT BE ĐẾN TRẢI NGHIỆM FPT TẠI GO!, GIẢM ĐẾN 50K, 1 VOUCHER ĐẠI TIỆC BÓNG ĐÁ FPT GIẢM 20% Tối đa 50k beBike /beCar (+Plus), 2, 3, Khám phá ưu đãi X3 GIẢI ĐẤU BẢNG THÔNG GIÁ CHỈ 0Đ, Vòng quay may mắn nhận quà hấp dẫn, Chụp ảnh photobooth, Thử thách penalty, Wi-Fi free, nước uống, sạc pin miễn phí, Bé tập tô màu, *Áp dụng cho các chuyến đi đến 12 điểm GO! toàn quốc

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image to preserve the route-map composition and information density.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown.
Maintain the light-blue event-map aesthetic with curved road and numbered waypoints.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square be x FPT event infographic poster with a light-blue map background. Place the be and FPT logos at the top left. Add a large blue headline 'ROAD TO ĐẠI TIỆC BÓNG ĐÁ FPT' with the subheadline 'ĐẶT BE ĐẾN TRẢI NGHIỆM FPT TẠI GO!' and a blue block 'GIẢM ĐẾN 50K'. Show a beBike scooter with two mascots and a soccer ball at the upper left, a GO! mall building at the upper right, and a detailed football activation zone with stage, field, booths, and posters in the lower center. Connect them using a wide curved blue road over a grid-map floor with numbered route markers. Add speech-bubble callouts for lucky wheel, photobooth, penalty challenge, free Wi-Fi water charging, and kids coloring. Technical style: isometric promotional infographic with event mockups and map graphics, bright graphic daylight, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark map, missing booths, incorrect logos, wrong text, low resolution, cluttered unreadable layout, muddy colors, watermark, signature
